calls.title: Lead Gen Brainstorming
calls.summary: The meeting addressed multiple aspects of Growth Book's strategies, beginning with the need for a website redesign to balance professionalism and a more engaging tone, reflecting investor feedback for a humorous and relatable brand image. Graham McNicoll emphasized the importance of clear migration processes for customers transitioning between self-hosted and cloud versions, while also clarifying terminology to avoid confusion. The team discussed lead generation, noting that a significant portion of signups stemmed from Google searches, with ongoing campaigns planned to boost conversion rates. A complete overhaul of onboarding practices was deemed necessary to improve user engagement and conversion, with proactive outreach to stalled users highlighted. Finally, the differentiation of Growth Book's SDK, particularly the Edge SDK's flicker-free capabilities, was identified as a competitive advantage in the market.
calls.keywords: Lead generation, onboarding, feature flagging, AI tooling, customer case studies, marketing campaigns
